mapper.select: SELECT menu_id, menu_nm, menu_key, menu_type, url, sort_order, required_role FROM menu ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT menu_id, menu_nm, menu_key, menu_type, url, sort_order, required_role FROM menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu (menu_nm, menu_key, menu_type, url, sort_order, required_role) VALUES (#{menuNm}, #{menuKey}, #{menuType}, #{url}, #{sortOrder}, #{requiredRole})
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET menu_nm = #{menuNm}, menu_key = #{menuKey}, menu_type = #{menuType}, url = #{url}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, required_role = #{requiredRole} WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
